name: Button
description: A versatile button component supporting various styles (primary, accent, outline, ghost, link, danger), sizes (xs, sm, md, lg, icon), loading states, active states for navigation, link behavior (internal/external), and icon integration. Uses V2 design tokens with color-mix() for interactive states.
usage: Use the `variant` prop to control the visual style. Default is 'outline' with gradient border and shadow.
Use the `size` prop to control the button dimensions.
Provide an `href` prop to render the button as a link (using Next.js Link for internal, `<a>` for external).
Set `external={true}` for links opening in a new tab.
Set `loading={true}` to display a spinner and disable the button.
Set `active={true}` to show the button in an active/selected state (e.g., for navigation).
Use the `Icon` prop (e.g., from lucide-react) to include an icon.
Use `iconOnly={true}` for buttons containing only an icon (requires `Icon` prop).
Set `fullWidth={true}` to make the button span its container's width.
examples:
```tsx
// Outline Button (Default) - gradient border with shadow
<Button>Click Me</Button>
```

```tsx
// Primary Button - solid primary background
<Button variant="primary">Submit</Button>
```

```tsx
// Accent Button - solid accent background
<Button variant="accent">Learn More</Button>
```

```tsx
// Link Button Opening Externally
<Button variant="link" href="https://example.com" external>Visit External Site</Button>
```
design: Use the 'primary' variant for the main call-to-action on a page or within a component.
Use 'accent' for complementary actions that pair with primary buttons.
Use 'outline' (default) for navigation buttons or less prominent actions with the gradient border style.
Use 'ghost' for actions within toolbars, tables, or inline where a filled button would be too heavy.
Use 'link' variant sparingly, primarily for navigation or actions that mimic standard hyperlinks.
Use the 'danger' variant exclusively for actions that have destructive consequences (e.g., delete, remove).
Maintain consistent sizing within sections where multiple buttons appear together.
For `iconOnly` buttons, ensure the icon choice clearly communicates the button's action. Provide an `aria-label` if the icon alone is not sufficient.
Avoid using `fullWidth` buttons in contexts where they might become excessively wide on large screens, unless constrained by a parent container.
Typography uses `.type-label` (14px medium) for md/lg sizes and `.type-label-sm` (12px medium) for xs/sm sizes.
accessibility: Focus states are handled with `focus-visible` styles.
When using `iconOnly={true}`, ensure meaningful text is provided either as `children` or via the `aria-label` prop for screen reader users.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual style variant of the button. Primary and accent have solid backgrounds with auto-calculated contrasting text. Outline (default) has gradient border with shadow. Ghost is transparent with state overlays. 'secondary' is deprecated (alias for 'accent').

props.name: active
props.description: When true, shows the button in an active/selected state with primary background. Useful for navigation buttons.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the button. 'xs' is extra small for compact UIs (h-7, px-2). 'icon' size is automatically used if `iconOnly` is true.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: If true, the button will take the full width of its container.

props.name: href
props.description: If provided, the button renders as a link (NextLink for internal, `<a>` for external).

props.name: external
props.description: If `href` is provided, set to true to open the link in a new tab (`target="_blank"`).

props.name: loading
props.description: If true, displays a spinning Loader2 icon (from lucide-react) in place of the Icon prop and disables the button. Text content remains visible. Uses currentColor for proper contrast across all variants.

props.name: disabled
props.description: If true, the button is disabled and interaction is prevented.

props.name: Icon
props.description: An optional icon component (e.g., from lucide-react) to display within the button.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Name of the Lucide icon to display (e.g., 'Home', 'Search', 'ArrowRight').

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Specifies the position of the icon relative to the button text.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: If true, styles the button specifically for displaying only an icon (requires the `Icon` prop).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the button element.
